hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) root=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -f "$root/scripts/check-architecture.ts" ] && { out=$(cd "$root" && bun scripts/check-architecture.ts 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; };; esac; exit 0
